workflow:
Hard-exclusion category 1: Multimodal models (gmm_25) with single-chain gradient samplers.

The 25-mode Gaussian mixture has modes separated by low-density regions. Any single-chain gradient sampler that starts in one mode will never cross to another without explicit mode-jumping mechanics (e.g., parallel tempering). Single-chain NUTS, HMC, MHMC, MALA, Barker, GHMC, MCLMC, adjusted_mclmc, dynamic_hmc, dmhmc, RWM, Orbital_HMC, and all Laplace-marginal variants cannot explore the full posterior.

The Tier-A reference for gmm_25 uses parallel-tempered SMC. The only valid recipe families for gmm_25 are SMC with any inner kernel (tempering anneals from prior = unimodal to full posterior = multimodal). Elliptical slice and mgrad_gaussian do not apply because gmm_25 has no Gaussian prior structure.

See RECIPE_GENERATION.md § Hard Exclusions Category 1 (lines 561-569) for the full context.
